description:
#Lasagna Lovers Unite: Create and Savor Two Irresistible Recipes—Classic Bolognese & Fresh Veggie Option!

Choose to learn how to make between 2 different Lasagna, a traditional bolognese one and vegetarian pesto and asparagus Lasagna! you will be able to enjoy it in our restaurant or bring home with you!
what_is_included: Every Class is about 2 hours. We'll provide you utensils, food and everything need to make it. Families, friends, and people curious about food are warmly welcome to join us for an authentic Italian experience!
